metric_definitions.driver_start_rss_mb: Python driver RSS before Spark and benchmark execution
metric_definitions.driver_spark_peak_rss_mb: Peak Python driver RSS during Spark transformation and Parquet streaming write
metric_definitions.driver_validation_peak_rss_mb: Peak Python driver RSS during bounded dataset streaming validation and ground-truth check
metric_definitions.driver_overall_peak_rss_mb: Absolute peak Python driver RSS observed across entire lifecycle
metric_definitions.driver_end_rss_mb: Python driver RSS at end of benchmark execution
metric_definitions.driver_peak_growth_mb: Peak driver RSS minus starting RSS (driver_overall_peak_rss_mb - driver_start_rss_mb)
metric_definitions.driver_growth_mb: Synonym for driver_peak_growth_mb (peak driver RSS minus starting RSS)
metric_definitions.jvm_child_peak_rss_mb: Peak sum of RSS across all child processes spawned by Spark (java.exe)
metric_definitions.process_tree_peak_rss_mb: Peak combined RSS of the process tree (Python driver + child JVM processes)

memory_metrics.bound_analysis: The PyArrow streaming writer bounds record batches to batch_size=1000 (~1 MB per batch) and iterates partitions using toLocalIterator(). Python driver process RSS operates between 49.88 MB and 125.64 MB. Concurrently, the JVM child process utilizes approximately 2098.39 MB for Spark's Catalyst engine, internal shuffle buffers, and Java heap. Total process tree peak memory reaches 2155.93 MB, reflecting the combined Java/Python runtime.
